eps.d: As Lloyd and Harvey await the arrival of their new foster sister, they wonder if she will be able to resist the mysterious powers of their sinister headmaster. Based on the books of Gillian Cross.
The boys get suspicious of Dinah's state of mind when she breaks one of the headmaster's rules. Based on Gillian Cross's books.
The Demon Headmaster's plans for Dinah are discovered - and SPLAT forms a counter-plan.

The latest craze is 'octopus dare' and junior computer brain of the year competition. Dinah is a natural contender, but her behaviour becomes very odd. Could it be that the evil headmaster is up to his new tricks in a bid to take over the world?
SPLAT have found a way in to Vulcan Tower, and the Computer Director is using mind control, but Dinah doesn't understand why - yet.

Three of the Brains have disappeared, along with Ian. Dinah begins to catch on to what is happening, and everything depends on SPLAT getting to her. Then there's the matter of the booby trap to consider.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again, Pt. 1
eps.d: The headmaster turns to genetic engineering to gain revenge over Dinah.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again, Pt. 2
eps.d: Rose embarks on her plan to drive a wedge between Dinah and her adopted brothers. Based on 'The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again' by Gillian Cross.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again, Pt. 3
eps.d: After Simon and Dinah's midnight visit to the BRC, Lloyd has gone missing. Dinah is no closer to finding the source of the buzzing or to indentifying the creeper.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again, Pt. 4
eps.d: Lloyd still lies in a coma. Dinah notices a reaction from him when a fly buzzes near him. No-one else sees the reaction and everyone says she must have been mistaken. Simon examines the wood he and Dinah found, and tells Dinah that only wasps chew like that. The Demon Headmaster tells Rose his plans - he must have Dinah at the lab, soon.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again, Pt. 5
eps.d: Simon has found his way into the BRC and into big trouble, while the Demon Headmaster is intent on his experiment with the egg.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again, Pt. 6
eps.d: The egg hatches. Demon Headmaster persuades Mrs Hunter to bring Dinah to the BRC, and his trap is set.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Strikes Again, Pt. 7
eps.d: Eve is programmed and Dinah has begun her quest to help Lloyd as the final contest begins.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Takes Over, Pt. 1
eps.d: The army accidentally triggers the cloning of the Demon Headmaster.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Takes Over, Pt. 2
eps.d: The Hunters are settling into their new house, but Harvey is uneasy – someone thinks they have seen the Demon Headmaster.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Takes Over, Pt. 3
eps.d: The Hunters have a puzzle on their hands.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Takes Over, Pt. 4
eps.d: The Headmaster's influence is spreading, and time is running out for Kate and Splat. Michael is still worried about his father, who hasn't returned home.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Takes Over, Pt. 5
eps.d: The Demon Headmaster goes to meet Dinah, but is she who he thinks she is? Meanwhile, the Lady is also on the prowl.

eps.t: The Demon Headmaster Takes Over, Pt. 6
eps.d: Only Dinah can save her mother and stop the Demon Headmaster from taking over the world.
